transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I came in because... well, I just keep feeling like I've completely let my family down. We took on this mortgage, and I just feel like it was a huge mistake that's all my fault. And then, at work, every time I mess up an order or drop something, it just proves to me that I'm useless. I just feel like I deserve whatever bad things happen to me right now.
Along with those feelings, have you been feeling consistently down, depressed, or sad most days?

Yeah, I have. Most days, um, there's just this heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. It's like I'm just going through the motions at the restaurant... carrying plates, smiling at people because I'm supposed to, not because I actually feel anything good. It's just kind of always there.
About how long have you been feeling this heavy, empty feeling most days?
I'd say it's been about a year and two months now. That's how long these depressed periods, and just feeling so guilty about everything, have been going on.
Have you ever had a period of time in your life when you felt the opposite—unusually energized, wired, or on top of the world?
No, I don't think so. I've never really felt like that. I just... I mostly just feel down, like I said. I don't get those kinds of highs or feel wired like that.
Before this past year and two months, have you ever experienced other times in your life when you felt depressed like this?

No, I don't think so. Um, before this started a little over a year ago, I never really dealt with anything like this. I mean, everyone has bad days, but I never felt this consistently down or empty before.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy doing?

Um, I don't really know. I guess I haven't really noticed a difference in that. I still do the same stuff I usually do, I just... I don't know, I just feel heavy while I'm doing it. But I wouldn't say I've lost interest.

My sleep? It's been pretty normal, honestly. I usually get about seven or eight hours a night. I don't really have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep, and I wake up at my usual time for work. So, yeah, no real changes there.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over this past year?

My eating has been kind of all over the place, honestly. Like, some weeks at work I barely even touch the staff meal, I just don't have the appetite for it. But then other nights, I'll come home after a shift and just... eat whatever I can find in the kitchen, just trying to feel settled, I guess. So it's definitely been fluctuating a lot.

{"intent": "Assess for difficulties with concentration or decision-making to evaluate depressive symptom criteria.", "question": "Have you found it harder to concentrate, focus on tasks, or make everyday decisions lately?"
